messages:
nora (People Ops): Quick draft: a tiny pack of shortform feedback & goal snippets for managers, peers, and ICs. Want super copy/paste lines for reviews and 1:1s. Thoughts? :seedling:

raj (Eng Manager): Love short. Can we include a two-minute peer feedback template? Useful for async asks.

nora (People Ops): Yep. Draft below — each line is paste-ready. Keep replies brief.

```
TWO-MINUTE PEER FEEDBACK (paste-ready)
- Strength: "Delivered clear instrumentation and tests for X; made debugging 3x faster."
- Area to grow: "Could pair earlier on rollout planning to reduce surprise infra work."
- One ask: "Would value a 30m pairing session on canary strategy next sprint."

MANAGER 1:1 PROMPTS (drop-in)
- "What's the one outcome this quarter you want me to unblock?"
- "If we only shipped half, which half keeps the most customer value?"
- "What's a risk I should escalate now vs solve locally?"

ONE-LINE IC SELF-REVIEW (paste-ready)
- Outcome: "Improved embeddings recall (NDCG@10) +12% for search rerank; rolled to canary."
- Contribution: "Authored model eval + infra changes; owned rollout plan."
- Ask: "Need 24h GPU credit for final validation + product signoff."

MANAGER CALIBRATION SIGNALS (one-word tags)
- ACHEIVED / NEAR / BLOCKED  (paste after review line)

NON-METRIC EXAMPLE (docs/research)
- Outcome: "Published 3 playbooks on observability; reduced on-call churn, 15% fewer pages."

HC / OPS TAGGING (so requests surface in flows)
- Add at end of ask line: [HC-REQ] or [INF-REQ] or [DATA-REQ]
```

carmen (PM): Nice. Suggest tweak: for product asks include timeframe like "by EOW" or "by end-of-quarter" so ops can triage.

elliot (Data Eng): Add a tiny privacy check reminder for data work: "If this touches PII, confirm DSR & retention with security."

nora (People Ops): Good catches — will add timeframe note and privacy one-liner in final. Also adding a micro-template for skip-levels: one-line manager context + one-line IC summary + tags.

hr-bot: Shortform feedback pack uploaded: https://redwood.internal/templates/shortform-feedback-v1 (auto) :white_check_mark:

raj (Eng Manager): Thanks @nora — will share in manager sync and ask managers to encourage peers to use the two-minute template before reviews.

nora (People Ops): Plan: finalize and pin in #people-ops templates by EOD. Ping me if you want a version with examples per level (IC/Staff/EM).
